How Trivial Legendary Creatures
items.skipReason: Trivia quiz, published 23 November 2020: thirty multiple-choice questions about legendary creatures, timed to Commander Legends. Judged by the same test applied to the other trivia columns - do the answers carry design argument? Here most do not. The bulk are lore identification (which plane a character is from, which gods are twins) and card-list enumeration (every card whose title names Ulamog). A handful of answers do carry something: Isamaru was designed on the spot to disprove a claim that no vanilla legendary could excite players; Atogatog got a design because art had already been commissioned for the cancelled Unglued 2; a rare poll run with the placeholder name Count Dracula changed how names are chosen before polling. Those three are each already covered - by act-of-war-part-1 (prove a risky idea with a working prototype), and by state-of-design-2022 and strixhaven-vision-design-handoff-document-part-1 on working titles going public. Not enough independent argument to reach seven lessons. Same treatment as how-trivial-vampires-2021-10-25 and trivial-pursuit-more-or-less; unlike trivial-pursuit-whats-in-a-name and trivial-pursuit-all-innistrad, which are summarized because their answers carry craft throughout.

Trivial Pursuit
items.skipReason: Trivia quiz, published 23 March 2020: thirty multiple-choice questions, one for each of thirty projects Rosewater led or co-led, a follow-up to the popular 25th-anniversary trivia column. Judged by the same test applied to the other trivia columns - do the answers carry design argument? Most do not. The bulk are card-list enumeration (how many cards with scry in Theros, how many legendary lands in Dominaria, which Ravnica Allegiance cards make Soldier tokens), debut identification (which set first printed Pacifism, which introduced the word create), and art or in-joke anecdotes (the earrings on B.F.M., the Vanguard life-total numbers, whether the Surgeon General likes teatime). About five answers carry something real: Aaron Forsythe was put on the Fifth Dawn design team to write an article about it, designed scry and sunburst, and was hired into R&D; Tom LaPille brought double-faced cards to Innistrad from Duel Masters, the Japan-only game allowed to push harder; Rosewater asked for Ixalan's two-sided conflict to become three-sided, with a fourth tribe added on need; the Scars block escalated its Phyrexian share from a minority to 50% to 90% across three sets; and convoke, built by Richard Garfield for the Boros, was moved to the Selesnya because it fit better. Of those, the punch-card and rehoming answers are already covered - by stepping-into-the-ring-part-1 (a physical accessory sets the frequency budget) and a-double-take-part-2 (rehome a rejected idea immediately). That leaves roughly three usable arguments, short of the seven a summary needs. Same treatment as how-trivial-legendary-creatures-2020-11-23, how-trivial-vampires-2021-10-25 and trivial-pursuit-more-or-less; unlike trivial-pursuit-whats-in-a-name and trivial-pursuit-all-innistrad, which are summarized because their answers carry craft throughout.

Mechanical Color Pie 2017
items.skipReason: First edition of the recurring mechanical colour pie reference, published 5 June 2017. Rosewater states the intent outright: "I am going to make this a feature I do every few years." The body is the enumeration itself - which colour is primary, secondary or tertiary in each of roughly a hundred effects, running to some 2,700 lines. The transferable craft is entirely in the framing, and all five of those points are already summarized from the 2021 edition: colour identity as a distribution rather than a permission list (primary/secondary/tertiary), the further a colour sits the narrower its door, a rare exception is not part of an identity, publish the state of the system rather than a constitution, and what is written is the centre not the border. The 2017 caveats are the same caveats, almost word for word. mechanical-color-pie-2021 and mechanical-color-pie-2021-changes are the instalments worth keeping; a second summary of the same framing would restate them with older numbers.
